reaction: I was interested that bacteria make molecules the colon lining can use, as well as gas.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was worthwhile because it connected water recovery and bacterial products to the lining's job of separating colon contents from blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the finished colon to the upper tract was clear but fairly predictable, since the picture already showed where they met.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some bacterial products can enter or fuel lining cells, and that breaking down fibre also produces gas.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals made the pairings clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see another connection between familiar organs and less familiar processes, although the straightforward assembly steps were sometimes predictable.
